accounts_email_or_phone.name: accounts_email_or_phone
accounts_email_or_phone.value: "accounts"."email" is not null or "accounts"."phone" is not null

people_nik_hash_uniq.name: people_nik_hash_uniq
people_nik_hash_uniq.where: "people"."nik_hash" is not null and "people"."deleted_at" is null

people_member_code_uniq.name: people_member_code_uniq
people_member_code_uniq.where: "people"."member_code" is not null and "people"."deleted_at" is null

role_assignments_scope.name: role_assignments_scope
role_assignments_scope.value:
("role_assignments"."role" = 'superadmin' and "role_assignments"."branch_id" is null and "role_assignments"."group_id" is null)
				or ("role_assignments"."role" in ('pastor', 'branch_admin') and "role_assignments"."branch_id" is not null and "role_assignments"."group_id" is null)
				or ("role_assignments"."role" = 'group_admin' and "role_assignments"."group_id" is not null and "role_assignments"."branch_id" is null)

member_profiles_baptism_details.name: member_profiles_baptism_details
member_profiles_baptism_details.value: "member_profiles"."baptized" = ("member_profiles"."baptism_date" is not null) and "member_profiles"."baptized" = ("member_profiles"."baptism_church" is not null)

member_profiles_sidi_details.name: member_profiles_sidi_details
member_profiles_sidi_details.value: "member_profiles"."sidi" = ("member_profiles"."sidi_date" is not null) and "member_profiles"."sidi" = ("member_profiles"."sidi_church" is not null)

registrations_contact.name: registrations_contact
registrations_contact.value: "registrations"."contact_email" is not null or "registrations"."contact_phone" is not null
